project.name: 拾遗 — 时空文化探索引擎
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 文化探索产品，暖调古纸质感底色+蓝红绿紫知识图谱节点色，宋体诗词排版，editorial叙事节奏，地图画布为核心交互
project.designRead: cultural explorer / general public / editorial warmth with cartographic precision / medium density / avoid cold tech dashboard feel

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: brand blue #2563eb for primary actions and navigation; entity colors (red/green/blue/purple) for knowledge graph nodes
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: multi-hue entity system: person=red, landmark=green, nature=blue, work=purple; warm antique background

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius: sm=4px, md=8px, lg=12px, xl=16px, full=9999px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: sans-serif for UI (system stack), serif Songti SC for poetry display, 1.5rem base, 2.4 line-height for poems
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base grid, compact but breathable for map-heavy layout
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: clean card-based, floating info cards, pill filters, timeline dots, border-first surfaces
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first with subtle shadow (alpha<=0.05 for static); floating layers use elevated/floating shadow
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: poetic Chinese landscape aesthetics; warm tones; cultural artifact feel

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: top header with logo, search bar, tab navigation (探索/发现); sidebar panel on desktop, bottom drawer on mobile
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: brand blue #2563eb for primary nav and CTAs; entity colors for node differentiation
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: system sans-serif for all UI text; Songti SC serif exclusively for poetry content display
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: warm antique background (#fafaf9), white cards with subtle border, floating layers use shadow
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: rounded-lg buttons with brand blue, clean and minimal, no heavy shadows on static elements
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content with generous padding for reading comfort; centered poetry display

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Warm antique-toned cultural product with multi-hue entity color system; Songti SC for poetry, system sans-serif for UI; map-centric layout with sidebar panels

productContext.productType: cultural exploration web app / interactive map-based knowledge explorer

pages.title: 探索页
pages.businessScenario: core exploration canvas with interactive map, timeline, and detail panels
pages.visualNorthStar: full-screen map as spatial canvas with warm antique overlay; floating info cards; elegant timeline at bottom
pages.compositionPattern: split composition: map takes 70% width, sidebar 30% on desktop; full map with bottom drawer on mobile
qualityRisks: map placeholder needs to look convincing

pages.title: 发现页
pages.businessScenario: content discovery hub with curated themes, famous poems, poets, and places
pages.visualNorthStar: editorial magazine layout with horizontal scrolling cards; warm cultural aesthetic; typography-driven sections
pages.compositionPattern: vertical editorial sections with horizontal scroll cards; each section has distinct visual identity

pages.title: 诗词详情页
pages.businessScenario: immersive poetry reading with Songti SC typography, creation background, author and place links
pages.visualNorthStar: centered Songti SC poetry display on warm gradient background; quote marks as decorative element; 2x2 info grid below
pages.compositionPattern: centered single-column editorial; poetry as hero element; supporting info in structured grid below
qualityRisks: Songti SC font may not render on all systems — need good fallback stack
